name: app_mcp_call
description: Runs any tool of a program's own MCP server that the node operator listed (Programmable App MCPs) and counts as a change: it needs a current backup unless the administrator switched that off. The program keeps its state for this session. Never automatically retry; a timed-out program is stopped and starts fresh.

program.description: Program id the node operator listed for app MCPs, for example filmcraft.

tool.description: Tool name of the program's own MCP server, from the app_mcp_read listing.

arguments.description: Arguments for the program's tool, as its schema describes them.

offset.description: Character offset to continue a long text answer at next_offset.

max_chars.description: Most characters of text to return; default 4000.

images.description: Return up to two images of the answer; images are omitted by default.

node.description: Registered node identifier; URLs are not accepted.

request_id.description: RFC 9562 UUIDv7 operation identifier. Generated by the gateway when omitted; never automatically retry a mutation.

next_steps.description: What the agent plans to do after this step, in plain words. The person at the machine sees it while the agent is paused or in slow motion. A refusal with code paused_by_person did nothing: observe again before the next step and never rerun a macro from its first step.
